{{Quote|Only the strongest has the right to rule the Sith! The title of Dark Lord of the Sith must be seized, wrenched from the all-powerful grasp of the Master!|Darth Bane|<ref name="Dynasty" />}}
A '''duel''' between the [[Sith Master/Legends|Sith Master]] [[Darth Bane/Legends|Darth Bane]] and his [[Sith apprentice/Legends|apprentice]], [[Darth Zannah/Legends|Darth Zannah]], took place on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ambria/Legends|Ambria]] in [[980 BBY]]. Bane had begun to fear that Zannah was waiting to challenge him until he grew weak, violating the purpose of his [[Rule of Two/Legends|Rule of Two]] to ensure that the apprentice took the title of Master only because the apprentice was stronger. Bane thus [[Mission to Prakith (Darth Bane)|sought]] the secret of eternal life so that he could live to train another apprentice. Meanwhile, Zannah had finally made her own plans to confront Bane in an attempt to become the Master, and upon learning of his quest for eternal life, she felt as though he had betrayed his own [[Order of the Sith Lords|Sith Order]]. She found and [[Duel on Doan|confronted]] him on the planet [[Doan]], but the [[Lightsaber duel/Legends|duel]] led to a draw. Bane found a new apprentice, the [[Iktotchi/Legends|Iktotchi]] [[Darth Cognus]], and messaged Zannah to come to Ambria and finish their fight. Upon Zannah's arrival, Cognus swore to serve the true master&mdash;whomever won the coming [[Lightsaber combat/Legends|battle]].

The duel began, and Bane instantly gained the upper hand, quickly forcing Zannah to give ground. She tripped while preparing to use a [[Sith sorcery/Legends|spell]] on him, and he cracked her rib before she was able to make an energy-draining escape. Zannah then attempted in vain to use [[Summon fear|sorcery]] to drive him insane and finally resorted to conjuring [[dark side tendrils]] from the ground. He charged her, hoping to strike her down before the tendrils hit him, but one connected with his arm and cut it off. Collapsing to the ground in pain, Bane grabbed Zannah and attempted to [[Essence transfer|transfer]] himself into her body, using the technique he had learned in his search for eternal life. Her will was too strong, however, and after an intense mental battle she defeated him, casting his consciousness into oblivion&mdash;although part of Bane remained imprinted upon her. Zannah took from Bane the mantle of [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] and, with Cognus as her apprentice, continued the legacy of Bane's [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] Order and the Rule of Two.

==Prelude==
===Prakith and Doan===
{{Quote|I know why you went to Prakith. I know you went after Andeddu's Holocron. I know you were searching for the secret to eternal life.''"<br />"''I did that out of necessity. I taught you everything I knew about the dark side. I waited for years for you to challenge me. But you were content to toil in my shadow, to remain an apprentice until the ravages of age robbed me of power. You are unworthy of becoming the Master, Zannah. That is why I went to Prakith.|Darth Zannah and Darth Bane|<ref name="Dynasty" />}}
In [[1000 BBY/Legends|1000 BBY]], the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Darth Bane/Legends|Darth Bane]] formed a new [[Order of the Sith Lords|Sith Order]] based on the principal of the [[Rule of Two/Legends|Rule of Two]], which allowed for the existence of only two [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] in the Order at any given time: a [[Sith Master/Legends|Master]] and an [[Sith apprentice/Legends|apprentice]]. The Rule was made so that in order for the apprentice to take the role of Master, the apprentice would have to defeat the Master in single combat, thus proving his or her superior strength and worthiness of the title. However, in [[980 BBY]], Bane began to grow concerned that his apprentice of twenty [[Standard year/Legends|years]], [[Darth Zannah/Legends|Darth Zannah]], was waiting until his already dying body weakened even further before she attacked him to take over the mantle of Dark [[Lord/Legends|Lord]]. As such, he embarked on a [[Mission to Prakith (Darth Bane)|mission]] to [[Prakith/Legends|Prakith]] to acquire [[Darth Andeddu]]'s [[Holocron of Heresies|holocron]], which was rumored to hold the secret to [[Immortality/Legends|eternal life]], so that he could live long enough to train a more suitable apprentice. He successfully obtained the [[Holocron/Legends|holocron]] and acquired from it the knowledge of [[essence transfer]]&mdash;a ritual in which one transferred one's consciousness into another's body.<ref name="Dynasty" />

Despite Bane's concerns, Zannah had finally begun to contemplate her move to overthrow her Master. On a [[Mission to Doan|mission]] to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Doan]], she learned of a [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]], [[Set Harth]], and tracked him down, [[Duel in Set Harth's mansion|enlisting]] him as her apprentice in preparation for her challenge of Bane. Meanwhile, [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Serra]] of Doan discovered that [[Caleb|her father]] had been [[Death/Legends|killed]] by a [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[990 BBY|ten years previously]]. Believing the Sith Lord to be [[Darth/Legends|Darth]] Bane&mdash;who, during the [[New Sith Wars]], had threatened to kill Serra if her father did not [[Force healing/Legends|heal]] him&mdash;she hired an [[Iktotchi/Legends|Iktotchi]] [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]], [[Darth Cognus|the Huntress]], to capture Bane and bring him to her. The Huntress, along with about twenty [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]], [[Skirmish in Darth Bane's mansion|ambushed]] Bane in [[Darth Bane's mansion|his mansion]] on [[Ciutric IV]] as he returned from his mission to Prakith. They captured him and took him to the [[Stone Prison]] on Doan, where Serra interrogated him.<ref name="Dynasty" />

===Duel on Doan===
{{Quote|Your time is over, Bane.|Darth Zannah, before attacking her Master in the Stone Prison|<ref name="Dynasty" />}}
[[File:DarthBane-frontal.jpg|thumb|left|225px|Dark Lord of the Sith Darth Bane]]
When Zannah returned with Harth to Ciutric IV and learned of Bane's quest for immortality, she grew furious, believing him to have betrayed his own Order. She and Harth tracked Bane to Doan, so that she could free him and challenge him. However, [[Lucia (soldier)|Serra's bodyguard]], who had served alongside Bane during the New Sith Wars, had already freed the Sith Lord. Bane began hunting down Serra in the [[Prison/Legends|prison]], but he was found and [[Duel on Doan|confronted]] by Zannah. She attacked Bane, who was still unarmed, as the Huntress had taken his [[Darth Bane's lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] after his capture. Serra witnessed their fight and decided to set the prison to [[Self-destruct mechanism/Legends|self-destruct]] and flee. Using [[The Force/Legends|the Force]], Bane held Zannah off long enough to hit one of the detonators in the wall with his [[Force lightning/Legends|Force lightning]], causing the passage to collapse between them and end the [[Lightsaber duel/Legends|duel]].<ref name="Dynasty" />

Zannah found that Harth had fled while she had fought Bane and realized her mistake in choosing him as her future apprentice. Meanwhile, Bane escaped the prison with the Huntress, who returned his [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] to him and submitted herself to his teachings, taking the name Darth Cognus. Aboard Cognus' [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]], the [[Stalker (shuttle)|''Stalker'']], they used the Iktotchi's [[Precognition/Legends|precognition]] to track Serra to the planet [[Ambria/Legends|Ambria]], where Bane allowed his new apprentice to kill the Princess. Bane then sent out a distress message to Zannah's [[Starship/Legends|starship]], the [[Victory (Theta-class T-1 vessel)|''Victory'']], telling her where he was. Zannah deduced that the message was not a trick; rather, it was an invitation to come to Ambria and finish what they had begun on Doan. She accepted the offer, deciding to finish the conflict instead of wasting years of their lives in a shadow war across the galaxy.<ref name="Dynasty" />

==The duel==
{{Quote|I wondered why you chose this place to meet. I thought it might have some symbolic meaning for you. The last time we were here you were too weak to even stand. You were helpless, and you thought I had betrayed you to the Jedi. You said you would rather die than be a prisoner for the rest of your life. You wanted me to take your life. But I refused.''"<br />"''You knew I still had things to teach you. You swore you would not kill me until you had learned all my secrets.''"<br />"''That day is here. I have surpassed you, Bane. Now I am the Master.''"<br />"''Then prove it.|Darth Zannah and Darth Bane|<ref name="Dynasty" />}}
[[File:DynastyofEvil-2022-cover-art.png|thumb|right|300px|The duel for the future of the Sith]]
As Zannah arrived at the camp the Sith exchanged words and Cognus swore loyalty to the true Sith Master&mdash;whomever won the duel&mdash;promising that she would not interfere. Bane then attacked Zannah, quickly pushing her back with the ferocity and power of his blows. He used several new techniques that he had never taught her before or used against her in their [[Sith training|training]] sessions. Nevertheless, her defense stayed strong, and Bane soon settled into a pattern of feints and quick thrusts. As he continued to drive her backward, Zannah began to gather her [[Force power/Legends|power]], preparing to unleash her [[Sith sorcery/Legends|sorcery]] against him, hoping to bring the duel to a quick end. However, Bane circled to come in on her left flank, and Zannah, her focus split between Bane and preparing her spell, failed to notice the freshly dug grave of Serra behind her. She stumbled on the grave and fell, and Bane immediately set upon her with a series of furious attacks, kicking and stomping at her, cracking one of her ribs. Zannah rolled with the impact, landed on her [[Limb/Legends|feet]], and threw herself into a series of back handsprings before finishing the jumps with a thrust meant to impale Bane. Bane, however, had stopped several [[Meter/Legends|meters]] back, letting her tire herself out with her extraneous flips.<ref name="Dynasty" />

Zannah quickly gathered the Force and attempted to overwhelm him with her sorcery, focusing on [[Summon fear|imprinting images]] of Bane's worst fears into his mind in an attempt to drive him insane. Although the ploy began to work at first, and Bane was [[Memory Walk|attacked in his mind's eye]] by demons of his abusive father, Bane had conquered his fears years before; he successfully summoned enough willpower to defeat the spells with a powerful blast of Force energy that sent Zannah flying backward. As Zannah rose to her feet, Bane charged at her once more. Desperate to end the duel, Zannah drew upon the power within Ambria itself and summoned [[Dark side tendrils|tendrils]] of pure [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] energy from the ground around them. She thrust the tendrils at Bane, who attempted to dodge the attack as he advanced on her.<ref name="Dynasty" />

One tendril clipped Bane's shoulder, causing him to fall to the ground in excruciating pain, greater than any pain he had ever felt before and filled with total fear of obliteration. Rising again to his feet, Bane charged Zannah, dodging the tendrils and realizing that his only hope was to cut her down before more tendrils hit him. When he was in range he struck out with his lightsaber, and Zannah, her focus split between the tendrils and defending herself from Bane, barely deflected the blow&mdash;but her [[Bane's Heart (lightsaber)|lightsaber]] was knocked from her grasp. However, as Bane went for the final, killing blow, his sword arm was cut off by one of the tendrils. Bane collapsed to the ground in pain, and, realizing he had no other choice left, he grabbed Zannah's wrist and began the ritual of essence transfer.<ref name="Dynasty" />

Bane's body was immediately destroyed, turning to ash as his consciousness transferred over to Zannah's body. However, he could still feel her consciousness within her as well, and she fought back. They engaged in a battle of wills, Bane seeking to obliterate her identity, while she attempted to force him out of her body. They were matched evenly for a moment, but Zannah finally defeated him, banishing his consciousness from within her.<ref name="Dynasty" /> Nevertheless, part of Bane remained imprinted upon Zannah, cursing her with his hand twitch.<ref name="Drew Karpyshyn" />

==Aftermath==
{{Quote|Bane reinvented the Sith. We are his legacy, and though he is gone his legacy will endure.|Darth Zannah, to Darth Cognus, after Zannah's victory|<ref name="Dynasty" />}}
[[File:DarthZannah-DoE.png|thumb|left|200px|Bane's successor, Darth Zannah]]
Cognus, who had watched the duel, cautiously approached Zannah, who rose to her feet, appearing to move awkwardly. Cognus asked if it was Bane, but Zannah replied that Bane was gone; she had defeated him and become the new Dark Lord of the Sith. Zannah took on Cognus as her apprentice, giving her Bane's old lightsaber to use until the Iktotchi constructed one of her own. She told Cognus that that they would continue Bane's legacy, and although individuals in the Order might die, the Order itself would live forever.<ref name="Dynasty" />

Bane's Order of the Sith Lords and the Rule of Two survived for over a thousand years,<ref name="Darth Bane: Rule of Two">''[[Darth Bane: Rule of Two]]''</ref><ref name="Return">{{Film|VI}}</ref> and in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], the Sith Lord [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]] finally achieved the goal of [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] domination with the creation of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].<ref name="Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith">{{Film|III}}</ref> However, following the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|deaths]] of Darth Sidious and [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]],<ref name="Return" /> Bane's Order was reorganized into a [[Lumiya's Sith|new order]] by the self-proclaimed Dark Lady of the Sith, [[Lumiya]], who continued to follow the Rule of Two. Finally, in [[41 ABY]], the Dark Lord [[Darth Caedus]] was [[Battle of Uroro Station|killed]] and his apprentice, [[Tahiri Veila]], redeemed, and the last vestiges of Bane's Order thus perished.<ref name="Legacy of the Force: Invincible">''[[Legacy of the Force: Invincible]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|Zannah won&mdash;Bane tried to possess her and failed.|Drew Karpyshyn|<ref name="Drew Karpyshyn" />}}
This duel was created by author [[Drew Karpyshyn]] to be the climax and the concluding confrontation of the final novel of the [[Star Wars: Darth Bane Trilogy|''Darth Bane Trilogy'']], ''[[Darth Bane: Dynasty of Evil]]'', released on [[December 8]], [[2009]]. The event served to kill the title character of Karpyshyn's trilogy, bringing the cycle of Darth Bane's life to an end.<ref name="Dynasty" /> When writing the scene, Karpyshyn knew that no matter who won the duel, readers would be angry at him for killing off a favorite character, but he did not want to avoid the question and "take the easy way out" by leaving the ending nebulous.<ref name="Drew Karpyshyn" />

Nevertheless, the ending of the novel led to an abundance of fan speculation as to whether or not Bane had actually succeeded in taking control over Zannah's body and was hiding this truth from Cognus&mdash;some fans even speculated that Bane had continued in this line of taking over the bodies of his apprentices right up through Darth Sidious. However, Karpyshyn revealed in a post on his Web site that this had not been his intent at all; he clarified that Zannah had won the battle of wills, and Bane had only managed to imprint part of his identity onto Zannah. Rather, it was the extent to which Bane had been imprinted on Zannah that Karpyshyn had intended to leave ambiguous.<ref name="Drew Karpyshyn" />
